# =====================================================================
#  Scraper default config
#  UDI-Compliant Scraper configuration schema for Prismata Scraper module.
#  This file defines the default configuration for the Scraper module.
#  Defines universal, portable, schema-agnostic merge behaviors
# =====================================================================

version: 1.0.0
registryName: "Scraper Default Configuration"
udiCompliant: true

# =====================================================================
# Scraper Input Spec - Folders
# =====================================================================

ignoreFolder:
  - ".git"
  - "node_modules"
  - "bin"
  - "obj"

includeFolders: null

excludeFolders:
  - ".workspace"
  - ".git"
  - "node_modules"
  - "bin"
  - "obj"

summarizeFolder:
  - ".workspace"

# =====================================================================
# Scraper Input Spec - Files
# =====================================================================

ignoreType: null

includeType:
  - ".ts"
  - ".py"
  - ".json"
  - ".yaml"
  - ".md"

excludeType: null

summarizeType:
  - ".ts"
  - ".py"
  - ".json"
  - ".yaml"
  - ".md"

# =====================================================================
# General Scraper Settings
# =====================================================================

FolderTree: true

AddFilesAsLeaves: true

AddTreeToScrapeFile: false

outputFolder: ".workspace/.scrapes"
